questions.text: द्विघात समीकरण (x − 1)² = 16 के मूल हैं :
questions.text_english: The roots of the quadratic equation (x − 1)² = 16 are :
questions.solution: Taking square root on both sides: x − 1 = ±4. So x = 1 + 4 = 5 or x = 1 − 4 = −3. The roots are 5 and −3, which is option C. Option A gives 5, 3 but 3 − 1 = 2 and 2² = 4 ≠ 16, so 3 is not a root. Option B gives 4, −4 but (4−1)² = 9 ≠ 16. Option D gives −5, 3 but (−5−1)² = 36 ≠ 16.

questions.text: दी गई आकृति में, केन्द्र O तथा 3 cm त्रिज्या वाले वृत्त पर दो स्पर्श रेखाएँ PQ तथा PR खींची गई हैं। यदि ∠QPR = 60° है, तो प्रत्येक स्पर्श रेखा की लम्बाई है :
questions.text_english: In the given figure, PQ and PR are tangents to a circle with centre O and radius 3 cm. If ∠QPR = 60°, then the length of each tangent is :
questions.image_description: A circle with centre O and radius 3 cm. From external point P, two tangents PQ and PR are drawn touching the circle at Q and R respectively. Angle QPR = 60° is marked at P.
questions.solution: Since OQ ⊥ PQ (radius is perpendicular to tangent), angle OQP = 90°. Since the two tangents from an external point are equal and OQ = OR = 3 cm, triangle OQP is a right triangle. Because ∠QPR = 60°, by symmetry ∠QPO = 30°. In right triangle OQP: tan 30° = OQ/PQ, so PQ = OQ/tan 30° = 3/(1/√3) = 3√3. Wait, re-checking: ∠QOP = 90° − ∠QPO = 60°, and using sin 60° = OQ/OP gives OP = 3/(sin 60°) = 3×2/√3 = 2√3. Then PQ = √(OP² − OQ²) = √(12−9) = √3. Hmm, let me redo: ∠QPR = 60° so ∠QPO = 30°. In right △OQP: sin(∠QPO) = OQ/OP ⇒ sin 30° = 3/OP ⇒ OP = 6. Then PQ = √(OP² − OQ²) = √(36−9) = √27 = 3√3. But option B is 3 cm. Re-checking with tan: tan 30° = OQ/PQ ⇒ PQ = OQ/tan 30° = 3÷(1/√3) = 3√3. That gives option A. However, if ∠OQP = 90° and ∠QPR = 60°, ∠QPO = 30°, then tan 30° = OQ/PQ so PQ = 3√3. Option A = 3√3 cm is correct.

questions.text: त्रिभुज DEF में AB ∥ EF है। x का मान है :
questions.text_english: In △DEF, AB ∥ EF. The value of x is :
questions.image_description: Triangle DEF with A on DE and B on DF such that AB is parallel to EF. DA = 2x, AE = 3x+1, DB = x, BF = 2x - 1/2.
questions.solution: Since AB ∥ EF, by Basic Proportionality Theorem (BPT): DA/AE = DB/BF. So 2x/(3x+1) = x/(2x − 1/2). Cross multiplying: 2x(2x − 1/2) = x(3x+1). Assuming x ≠ 0, divide both sides by x: 2(2x − 1/2) = 3x+1. So 4x − 1 = 3x+1, giving x = 2. Checking x = 0: DA = 0 which is not valid as A would coincide with D. So x = 2 only, which is option B.

options.A: एक अभाज्य संख्या है / a prime number
options.B: 13 से विभाजित होती है / divisible by 13
options.C: एक भाज्य संख्या है / a composite number
options.D: एक विषम संख्या है / an odd number

questions.solution: 3 × 11 × 13 + 3 = 3(11 × 13 + 1) = 3(143 + 1) = 3 × 144 = 432. Since 432 = 3 × 144 has more than two factors, it is a composite number. It is not prime (option A) since it has factors other than 1 and itself. It is not divisible by 13: 432/13 ≈ 33.2, not an integer (option B is wrong). It is even (432 = 2 × 216), so option D is also wrong. Hence option C is correct.

questions.text: दो पासे एक साथ फेंके जाते हैं। प्राप्त संख्याओं का योगफल 6 से भाज्य होने की प्रायिकता है :
questions.text_english: Two dice are rolled together. The probability that the sum of the numbers obtained is divisible by 6, is :
questions.solution: Total outcomes when two dice are rolled = 36. Sums divisible by 6 are 6 and 12. Outcomes giving sum 6: (1,5),(2,4),(3,3),(4,2),(5,1) = 5 outcomes. Outcomes giving sum 12: (6,6) = 1 outcome. Total favourable outcomes = 6. Probability = 6/36 = 1/6. Hence option A is correct.

questions.text: 12 तथा 250 के बीच की संख्याओं में 4 के गुणजों की संख्या है :
questions.text_english: The number of multiples of 4 lying between 12 and 250 is :
questions.solution: Multiples of 4 between 12 and 250 (strictly between, not including 12 and 250): first multiple is 16, last multiple is 248. Number of terms = (248 − 16)/4 + 1 = 232/4 + 1 = 58 + 1 = 59. Hence option A is correct. Option B is not an integer, so it cannot be a count. Options C and D would include 12 or 250 which are not between them.

questions.text: एक ठोस घन में से, जिसके प्रत्येक किनारे की लम्बाई l है, अधिकतम आकार का शंकु खोदकर निकाला जाता है। शंकु का आयतन है :
questions.text_english: A cone of maximum size is carved out from a solid cube of edge length l. The volume of the cone is :
questions.image_description: A solid cube of edge length l with a cone of maximum size carved out from it. The cone fits inside the cube with its base circle inscribed in one face.
questions.solution: The maximum cone that can be carved from a cube of edge l has its base as the largest circle that fits in a face of the cube, so radius r = l/2, and height h = l. Volume of cone = (1/3)πr²h = (1/3)π(l/2)²(l) = (1/3)π(l²/4)(l) = πl³/12. This matches option A.
questions.topic: Volume of cone carved from cube

questions.text: समीकरण 2x − 6y = 7 को निरूपित करने वाली रेखा के समांतर एक अन्य रेखा का समीकरण है :
questions.text_english: Equation of another line parallel to the line represented by 2x − 6y = 7 is :
questions.solution: The given line 2x − 6y = 7 can be written as x − 3y = 7/2, with slope = 1/3. For a parallel line, the slope must also be 1/3. Option A: y = 3x − 7, slope = 3 (not parallel). Option B: 2x + 6y = 9, slope = −1/3 (not parallel). Option C: x − 3y = 7, rearranged as x − 3y = 7. Dividing by 1: slope = 1/3 (same as given line, and 7 ≠ 7/2 so they are distinct parallel lines). Option D: x = 7/2 − 3y means x + 3y = 7/2, slope = −1/3 (not parallel). Hence option C is correct.
questions.chapter: Pair of Linear Equations in Two Variables

questions.text: यदि किसी मीनार की छाया की लम्बाई उसकी ऊँचाई की √3 गुना है, तो सूर्य का उन्नतांश है :
questions.text_english: If the length of the shadow of a tower is √3 times that of its height, then altitude of the Sun is :
questions.solution: Let height of tower = h and shadow = √3h. The angle of elevation θ satisfies tan θ = height/shadow = h/(√3h) = 1/√3. Since tan 30° = 1/√3, the altitude of the sun is 30°. Option A (45°) would require shadow = height. Option C (60°) would require shadow = h/√3. Option D (15°) gives a much longer shadow. Hence option B is correct.

questions.text: यदि द्विघात समीकरण √3 x² − kx + 2√3 = 0 के मूल वास्तविक तथा समान हैं, तो k का मान है :
questions.text_english: If the roots of the quadratic equation √3 x² − kx + 2√3 = 0 are real and equal, then the value(s) of k is/are :
questions.solution: For real and equal roots, discriminant D = 0. Here a = √3, b = −k, c = 2√3. D = b² − 4ac = k² − 4(√3)(2√3) = k² − 4 × 2 × 3 = k² − 24 = 0. So k² = 24, giving k = ±√24. Hence option A is correct.

questions.text_english: The nᵗʰ term of the A.P. −1/3, 2/3, 5/3, 8/3, ... is :
questions.solution: First term a = −1/3, common difference d = 2/3 − (−1/3) = 3/3 = 1. nᵗʰ term = a + (n−1)d = −1/3 + (n−1)(1) = −1/3 + n − 1 = n − 4/3 = (3n − 4)/3. Checking option D: (n−4)/3: for n=1, (1−4)/3 = −1 ≠ −1/3. Checking option B: n − 4/3 = (3n−4)/3: for n=1, (3−4)/3 = −1/3 ✓; n=2, (6−4)/3 = 2/3 ✓. So the answer is option B. Wait, let me recheck option D: (n−4)/3 for n=1 is −3/3 = −1, not −1/3. So option D is wrong. Option B: n − 4/3 = (3n−4)/3. For n=1: (3−4)/3 = −1/3 ✓. The correct answer is B.

questions.text: दी गई आकृति में, केन्द्र O तथा त्रिज्या r वाले वृत्त पर खींची गई स्पर्श रेखा PT है। यदि ∠POT = 45° है, तो OP की लम्बाई है :
questions.text_english: In the given figure, PT is a tangent to the circle with centre O and radius r. If ∠POT = 45°, then the length of OP is :
questions.image_description: A circle with centre O and radius r. T is the point of tangency on the circle. PT is a tangent drawn from external point P. Angle POT = 45° is marked at centre O.
questions.solution: Since OT ⊥ PT (radius is perpendicular to tangent), angle OTP = 90°. In right triangle OTP: angle POT = 45°, angle OTP = 90°, so angle TPO = 45°. Using cos(∠POT) = OT/OP: cos 45° = r/OP, so OP = r/cos 45° = r/(1/√2) = r√2. Options A and B are the same value (r√2 = √2r), but the standard notation in option A is r√2. Hence option A is correct.

questions.text: दिया गया है कि △ABC ~ △QRP है जहाँ AB = 9 cm, BC = 5 cm तथा PR = 2 cm है। भुजा QR की लम्बाई है :
questions.text_english: It is given that △ABC ~ △QRP such that AB = 9 cm, BC = 5 cm and PR = 2 cm. Length of side QR is :
questions.solution: Since △ABC ~ △QRP, corresponding sides are proportional: AB/QR = BC/RP = AC/QP. So AB/QR = BC/PR gives 9/QR = 5/2. Therefore QR = (9 × 2)/5 = 18/5 = 3.6 cm. Wait, that is option D. Re-checking correspondence: A↔Q, B↔R, C↔P. So AB corresponds to QR, BC corresponds to RP, CA corresponds to PQ. Hence AB/QR = BC/RP ⇒ 9/QR = 5/2 ⇒ QR = 18/5 = 3.6 cm. But wait, PR = 2 cm and RP is the same as PR, so BC/RP = 5/2. Then 9/QR = 5/2 giving QR = 18/5 = 3.6 cm. So option D is correct.

questions.text: द्विघात बहुपद p(x) के शून्यकों का योगफल तथा गुणनफल क्रमश: −1/3 तथा 2 है। बहुपद p(x) है :
questions.text_english: The sum and product of zeroes of a quadratic polynomial p(x) are −1/3 and 2 respectively. The polynomial p(x) is :
questions.solution: A quadratic polynomial with sum of zeroes S = −1/3 and product P = 2 is k[x² − Sx + P] = k[x² + (1/3)x + 2]. Multiplying by k = 3: 3x² + x + 6. Hmm, that gives +x not −x. Let me check option A: 3x² − x + 6. Sum of zeroes = 1/3 (not −1/3) and product = 6/3 = 2. So sum is 1/3, not matching. For option D: −3x² − x − 6. Sum = −(−1)/(−3) = −1/3 ✓, product = −6/(−3) = 2 ✓. So option D is correct.
questions.topic: Constructing polynomial from sum and product of zeroes

questions.text: दिया गया है कि sin 2α = √3/2 है। sin 3α का मान है :
questions.text_english: Given that sin 2α = √3/2, the value of sin 3α is :
questions.solution: sin 2α = √3/2 implies 2α = 60° (taking the principal value), so α = 30°. Therefore 3α = 90°, and sin 90° = 1. Hence option C is correct. Option A (3√3/4) and option D (√3/4) do not equal sin 90°. Option B (1/2) = sin 30° but we need sin 3α = sin 90°.

questions.text: एक बंटन के माध्यक तथा बहुलक क्रमश: 25.2 तथा 26.1 हैं। इस बंटन का माध्य है :
questions.text_english: The median and mode of a distribution are 25.2 and 26.1 respectively. The mean of the distribution is :
questions.solution: Using the empirical relation: Mode = 3 Median − 2 Mean. Substituting: 26.1 = 3(25.2) − 2 Mean. So 26.1 = 75.6 − 2 Mean, giving 2 Mean = 75.6 − 26.1 = 49.5, hence Mean = 24.75. This matches option A.
questions.topic: Empirical relation between mean, median and mode

questions.text: दी गई आकृति में, △ABC एक समबाहु त्रिभुज है। बिंदुओं A(0, 5√3/2) तथा D(0, 0) को जोड़ने वाली माध्यिका AD है। बिंदु B तथा C के निर्देशांक (इसी क्रम में) हैं :
questions.text_english: In the given figure, △ABC is an equilateral triangle. AD is a median of the triangle joining the points A(0, 5√3/2), D(0, 0). Points B and C are (in same order) :
questions.image_description: Equilateral triangle ABC with vertex A at (0, 5√3/2) at the top and base BC on the x-axis. D(0,0) is the midpoint of BC (foot of median from A). Points B and C are on the x-axis symmetrically about the origin.
questions.solution: AD is the median from A(0, 5√3/2) to D(0, 0), so AD = 5√3/2. In an equilateral triangle, the median equals (√3/2) × side. So (√3/2) × side = 5√3/2, giving side = 5. Since D is the midpoint of BC and D = (0, 0), B and C are at (−5/2, 0) and (5/2, 0). But BC = 5, so BD = 5/2 each, meaning B = (−5/2, 0) and C = (5/2, 0). That is option B. Let me verify: side BC = 5, so half = 5/2. Points are (−5/2, 0) and (5/2, 0). But option A gives (−5, 0) and (5, 0), where BC = 10. Let us check: if side = 10, median = (10√3)/2 = 5√3 ≠ 5√3/2. If side = 5, median = 5√3/2 ✓. So option B is correct.

questions.text: ((1/2) tan² 45° − cos² 60°) का मान है :
questions.text_english: The value of ((1/2) tan² 45° − cos² 60°) is :
questions.solution: tan 45° = 1, so tan² 45° = 1. cos 60° = 1/2, so cos² 60° = 1/4. Therefore (1/2)(1) − (1/4) = 1/2 − 1/4 = 2/4 − 1/4 = 1/4. This matches option C.

अभिकथन (A): किसी वृत्त के केन्द्र से स्पर्श रेखा की न्यूनतम दूरी, त्रिज्या के बराबर होती है।

questions.instruction_line: प्रश्न संख्या 19 और 20 अभिकथन एवं तर्क आधारित प्रश्न हैं। दो कथन दिए गए हैं जिनमें एक को अभिकथन (A) तथा दूसरे को तर्क (R) द्वारा अंकित किया गया है। इन प्रश्नों के सही उत्तर नीचे दिए गए कोडों (A), (B), (C) और (D) में से चुनकर दीजिए।
questions.instruction_line_english: Questions 19 and 20 are Assertion-Reason based questions. Two statements are given, one labelled as Assertion (A) and the other as Reason (R). Select the correct answer from the codes (A), (B), (C) and (D) given below.

options.A: अभिकथन (A) और तर्क (R) दोनों सही हैं और तर्क (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या करता है।

options_english.B: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true, but Reason (R) is not the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options_english.C: Assertion (A) is true, but Reason (R) is false.

questions.solution: The Assertion (A) is true: the shortest distance from the centre to the tangent line is the perpendicular distance, which equals the radius. The Reason (R) is also true: the radius to the point of tangency is perpendicular to the tangent. Moreover, R correctly explains A, because since the radius is perpendicular to the tangent, it is the shortest distance from the centre to the tangent. Hence option A is correct.

questions.solution: Assertion A: At θ = 45°, 2θ = 90°, and tan 90° is undefined. So assertion A is TRUE. Reason R: sin 90° = 1 and cos 90° = 0, so sin 90° ≠ cos 90° is TRUE. However, R does not correctly explain A because the reason tan 90° is undefined is that cos 90° = 0 (making the denominator zero), not simply because sin 90° ≠ cos 90°. Hence both are true but R is not the correct explanation of A. Option B is correct.

questions.text: लकड़ी के उस पट्टे (Plank) की लम्बाई बताइए जिसकी सहायता से 4 m 20 cm तथा 5 m 4 cm लम्बाई को न्यूनतम समय में पूरा-पूरा नापा जा सके।
questions.text_english: Find the length of the plank that can be used to measure the lengths 4 m 20 cm and 5 m 4 cm exactly, in the least time.

key_points: Convert both lengths to cm: 420 cm and 504 cm.
Find HCF of 420 and 504 using prime factorisation or Euclid's algorithm.
HCF = 84 cm, so the plank length is 84 cm.

questions.solution: Converting: 4 m 20 cm = 420 cm and 5 m 4 cm = 504 cm. To measure both lengths exactly, the plank must be a common factor of 420 and 504. To do so in the least number of measurements, we need the greatest such length, i.e., the HCF. Prime factorisation: 420 = 2² × 3 × 5 × 7 and 504 = 2³ × 3² × 7. HCF = 2² × 3 × 7 = 84. Therefore, the length of the plank is 84 cm.

sub_questions.text: वर्ग ABCD के विकर्ण AC तथा BD बिंदु P पर प्रतिच्छेद करते हैं। बिंदु B तथा D के निर्देशांक क्रमश: (9, −2) तथा (1, 6) हैं। (i) बिंदु P के निर्देशांक ज्ञात कीजिए। (ii) वर्ग की भुजा की लम्बाई ज्ञात कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: Diagonals AC and BD of square ABCD intersect at P. Coordinates of points B and D are (9, −2) and (1, 6) respectively. (i) Find the co-ordinates of point P. (ii) Find the length of the side of the square.
sub_questions.solution: The diagonals of a square bisect each other, so P is the midpoint of BD. P = ((9+1)/2, (−2+6)/2) = (10/2, 4/2) = (5, 2). Length of diagonal BD = √((9−1)² + (−2−6)²) = √(64 + 64) = √128 = 8√2. In a square, diagonal = side × √2, so side = 8√2/√2 = 8 units.

questions.text: चतुर्भुज ABCD के विकर्ण परस्पर बिंदु O पर इस प्रकार प्रतिच्छेद करते हैं कि AO/OC = BO/OD है। दर्शाइए कि चतुर्भुज ABCD एक समलम्ब है।
questions.text_english: The diagonals of a quadrilateral ABCD intersect each other at the point O such that AO/OC = BO/OD. Show that quadrilateral ABCD is a trapezium.

key_points: Draw EO parallel to AB through O meeting BC at E. Use BPT to show EO || DC as well, leading to AB || DC.

questions.solution: Given: AO/OC = BO/OD. Draw EO ∥ AB where E is on BC. In △ABC, EO ∥ AB, so by BPT: CE/EB = CO/OA ⇒ CE/EB = OC/OA. Also given AO/OC = BO/OD ⇒ OA/OC = OB/OD ⇒ OC/OA = OD/OB. So CE/EB = OD/OB. In △BCD, by converse of BPT: if CE/EB = OD/OB, then EO ∥ DC. But EO ∥ AB (by construction). Therefore AB ∥ DC, meaning ABCD is a trapezium.

questions.text: 7 cm त्रिज्या वाले अर्धगोले पर एक शंकु को अध्यारोपित करके एक खिलौना बनाया गया है। खिलौने की कुल ऊँचाई 31 cm है। खिलौने का सम्पूर्ण पृष्ठीय क्षेत्रफल ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.text_english: A toy is in the form of a cone mounted on a hemisphere of radius 7 cm. The total height of the toy is 31 cm. Find the total surface area of the toy.

key_points: Radius r = 7 cm, total height = 31 cm, cone height = 31 - 7 = 24 cm.
Slant height l = sqrt(24^2 + 7^2) = sqrt(576 + 49) = sqrt(625) = 25 cm.

questions.image_description: A toy consisting of a cone mounted on a hemisphere. The hemisphere has radius 7 cm. The total height of the toy is 31 cm. The combined shape looks like a pointed top with a rounded base.
questions.solution: Radius r = 7 cm. Total height = 31 cm, so height of cone h = 31 − 7 = 24 cm. Slant height of cone l = √(h² + r²) = √(576 + 49) = √625 = 25 cm. Total surface area = curved surface area of cone + curved surface area of hemisphere = πrl + 2πr² = (22/7)(7)(25) + 2(22/7)(49) = 550 + 308 = 858 cm².

sub_questions.text: यदि sin θ + cos θ = √3 है, तो सिद्ध कीजिए कि tan θ + cot θ = 1 है।
sub_questions.text_english: If sin θ + cos θ = √3, then prove that tan θ + cot θ = 1.

key_points: Square both sides: sin^2 theta + cos^2 theta + 2 sin theta cos theta = 3.
1 + 2 sin theta cos theta = 3, so sin theta cos theta = 1.
tan theta + cot theta = sin/cos + cos/sin = (sin^2+cos^2)/(sin cos) = 1/(1) = 1.

sub_questions.solution: Given sin θ + cos θ = √3. Squaring both sides: sin²θ + 2sinθcosθ + cos²θ = 3. Since sin²θ + cos²θ = 1: 1 + 2sinθcosθ = 3, so sinθcosθ = 1. Now tanθ + cotθ = sinθ/cosθ + cosθ/sinθ = (sin²θ + cos²θ)/(sinθcosθ) = 1/1 = 1. Hence proved.

sub_questions.text: सिद्ध कीजिए: (sin A + sec A)² + (cos A + cosec A)² = (1 + sec A cosec A)²
sub_questions.text_english: Prove that: (sin A + sec A)² + (cos A + cosec A)² = (1 + sec A cosec A)²

key_points: Expand LHS: sin^2A + 2sinA.secA + sec^2A + cos^2A + 2cosA.cosecA + cosec^2A.
= 1 + 2(sinA/cosA) + sec^2A + 2(cosA/sinA) + cosec^2A.
= 1 + 2(sin^2A + cos^2A)/(sinAcosA) + sec^2A + cosec^2A = 1 + 2/(sinAcosA) + sec^2A + cosec^2A.
RHS = 1 + 2secAcosecA + sec^2Acosec^2A. Show both equal 1 + 2/(sinAcosA) + 1/(sin^2Acos^2A).

sub_questions.solution: LHS = (sin A + sec A)² + (cos A + cosec A)². Expanding: sin²A + 2sinA · secA + sec²A + cos²A + 2cosA · cosecA + cosec²A = (sin²A + cos²A) + 2(sinA/cosA) + 2(cosA/sinA) + sec²A + cosec²A = 1 + 2(sin²A + cos²A)/(sinAcosA) + sec²A + cosec²A = 1 + 2/(sinAcosA) + 1/cos²A + 1/sin²A = 1 + 2/(sinAcosA) + (sin²A + cos²A)/(sin²Acos²A) = 1 + 2/(sinAcosA) + 1/(sin²Acos²A). RHS = (1 + secAcosecA)² = 1 + 2secAcosecA + sec²Acos ec²A = 1 + 2/(sinAcosA) + 1/(sin²Acos²A). LHS = RHS. Hence proved.

questions.text: दी गई आकृति में, 7 cm त्रिज्या वाले वृत्त के केन्द्र पर जीवा AB 120° का कोण अंतरित करती है। ज्ञात कीजिए (i) दीर्घ त्रिज्यखंड OACB का परिमाप, और (ii) छायांकित भाग का क्षेत्रफल, यदि △OAB का क्षेत्रफल 21.2 cm² है।
questions.text_english: In the given figure, chord AB subtends an angle of 120° at the centre of the circle with radius 7 cm. Find (i) perimeter of major sector OACB, and (ii) area of the shaded segment, if area of △OAB = 21.2 cm².

key_points: (i) Major sector angle = 360 - 120 = 240 degrees. Arc length = (240/360) x 2pi x 7 = 88/3 cm. Perimeter = 88/3 + 7 + 7 = 88/3 + 14 = (88 + 42)/3 = 130/3 cm.
(ii) Area of minor sector = (120/360) x pi x 7^2 = (1/3)(22/7)(49) = 154/3 cm^2. Area of shaded segment = 154/3 - 21.2 = 51.33 - 21.2 = 30.13 cm^2 approx.

questions.image_description: A circle with centre O and radius 7 cm. Chord AB subtends angle AOB = 120° at the centre. The shaded region is the minor segment (area between chord AB and minor arc AB). The major sector OACB is the region containing centre O bounded by radii OA, OC (passing through top) and OB.
questions.solution: (i) The minor arc angle is 120°, so the major arc angle is 360° − 120° = 240°. Length of arc ACB (major arc) = (240/360) × 2πr = (2/3) × 2 × (22/7) × 7 = (2/3) × 44 = 88/3 cm. Perimeter of major sector OACB = arc length + OA + OB = 88/3 + 7 + 7 = 88/3 + 14 = (88 + 42)/3 = 130/3 ≈ 43.33 cm. (ii) Area of minor sector OAB = (120/360) × πr² = (1/3) × (22/7) × 49 = (1/3) × 154 = 154/3 cm². Area of shaded (minor) segment = Area of minor sector − Area of △OAB = 154/3 − 21.2 = 51.33 − 21.2 ≈ 30.13 cm².
questions.topic: Perimeter of sector, area of segment

questions.text: सिद्ध कीजिए कि √5 एक अपरिमेय संख्या है।
questions.text_english: Prove that √5 is an irrational number.

key_points: Assume sqrt(5) is rational, so sqrt(5) = p/q where p, q are coprime integers with q != 0.
Squaring: 5q^2 = p^2, so 5 | p^2, hence 5 | p. Write p = 5m.
Then 5q^2 = 25m^2 => q^2 = 5m^2, so 5 | q, contradicting p and q being coprime.

questions.solution: Assume √5 is rational. Then √5 = p/q where p and q are co-prime integers and q ≠ 0. Squaring both sides: 5 = p²/q², so p² = 5q². This means 5 divides p², and since 5 is prime, 5 divides p. Write p = 5k for some integer k. Then p² = 25k², substituting: 25k² = 5q², giving q² = 5k². This means 5 divides q², and hence 5 divides q. But then 5 is a common factor of both p and q, which contradicts our assumption that p and q are co-prime. Therefore, √5 is irrational.

questions.text: दो ऐसे क्रमागत ऋणात्मक पूर्णांक ज्ञात कीजिए जिनके वर्गों का योगफल 481 है।
questions.text_english: Find two consecutive negative integers, sum of whose squares is 481.

key_points: Let integers be x and x+1 (consecutive negative), x < 0.
x = (-1 +/- sqrt(1 + 960))/2 = (-1 +/- 31)/2. Taking negative root: x = -16, so integers are -16 and -15.

questions.solution: Let the two consecutive negative integers be x and x + 1, where x < 0. Then x² + (x+1)² = 481. Expanding: x² + x² + 2x + 1 = 481, giving 2x² + 2x − 480 = 0, i.e., x² + x − 240 = 0. Using the quadratic formula: x = [−1 ± √(1 + 960)]/2 = [−1 ± √961]/2 = [−1 ± 31]/2. Taking the negative value: x = (−1 − 31)/2 = −32/2 = −16. The two consecutive negative integers are −16 and −15.

questions.text: बिंदु P(x, 7), बिंदुओं A(− 5, 4) तथा B(7, 9) को जोड़ने वाले रेखाखंड को एक निश्चित अनुपात में विभाजित करता है। वह अनुपात तथा x का मान ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.text_english: A point P(x, 7) divides a line segment joining the points A(− 5, 4) and B(7, 9) in a certain ratio. Find the ratio and hence find the value of x.

key_points: Let ratio be k:1. y-coordinate: (9k + 4)/(k+1) = 7 => 9k + 4 = 7k + 7 => 2k = 3 => k = 3/2. Ratio = 3:2.

questions.solution: Let P(x, 7) divide AB in ratio k : 1. Using section formula for y-coordinate: y = (k × 9 + 1 × 4)/(k + 1) = 7. So 9k + 4 = 7(k + 1) = 7k + 7, giving 2k = 3, hence k = 3/2. The ratio is 3:2. For x-coordinate: x = (k × 7 + 1 × (−5))/(k + 1) = ((3/2)(7) + (−5))/((3/2) + 1) = (21/2 − 5)/(5/2) = (11/2)/(5/2) = 11/5. Therefore x = 11/5 and ratio = 3:2.

sub_questions.text: बाह्य बिंदु P से, O केन्द्र वाले वृत्त पर स्पर्श रेखाएँ PA तथा PB खींची गई हैं। सिद्ध कीजिए कि ∠APB = 2 ∠OAB है।
sub_questions.text_english: Two tangents PA and PB are drawn to a circle with centre O from an external point P. Prove that ∠APB = 2 ∠OAB.

key_points: PA = PB (tangents from external point), so triangle PAB is isosceles.
Let angle APB = 2alpha. Then angle PAB = angle PBA = 90 - alpha.
OA perpendicular to PA so angle OAB = 90 - angle PAB = 90 - (90 - alpha) = alpha = angle APB / 2.

sub_questions.solution: Since PA and PB are tangents from P to the circle with centre O, we have PA = PB (tangents from an external point are equal) and OA ⊥ PA. Let ∠APB = 2α. Since △PAB is isosceles (PA = PB), ∠PAB = ∠PBA = (180° − 2α)/2 = 90° − α. Since OA ⊥ PA, ∠OAP = 90°. Therefore ∠OAB = ∠OAP − ∠PAB = 90° − (90° − α) = α. So ∠OAB = α = ∠APB/2, which means ∠APB = 2∠OAB. Hence proved.

sub_questions.text: दी गई आकृति में, PA, O केन्द्र वाले वृत्त पर खींची गई ऐसी स्पर्श रेखा है कि OA = 10 cm, AB = 8 cm तथा AB ⊥ OP है। PB की लम्बाई ज्ञात कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: In the given figure, PA is the tangent to the circle with centre O such that OA = 10 cm, AB = 8 cm and AB ⊥ OP. Find the length of PB.

key_points: OB = sqrt(OA^2 - AB^2) = sqrt(100 - 64) = 6 cm (radius).
OA perpendicular to PA, so in right triangle OAP, OP^2 = OA^2 + PA^2. Also AB perpendicular to OP.
Using power of a point or direct calculation: PB = sqrt(OP^2 - r^2) via tangent PA...

sub_questions.solution: OA = 10 cm, AB = 8 cm, AB ⊥ OP, OA ⊥ PA (tangent). In right triangle OAB: OB² = OA² − AB² = 100 − 64 = 36, so OB = 6 cm (this is the radius r = 6 cm). Now AB ⊥ OP, and OB = 6, AB = 8. In right triangle ABP: PA = ? We need OP. Since OA ⊥ PA, in right △OAP: OP² = OA² + AP². Also since B is on OP and AB ⊥ OP, BP = √(AB² + AP²) ... Let OB = 6 (radius), OA = 10. In right triangle OAB (where angle ABo = 90°, because AB⊥OP): OB² + AB² = OA² does not hold: 36+64=100 ✓. So angle at B = 90°, OB = 6, AB = 8, OA = 10. Now OP is along OB extended (since AB ⊥ OP means B is foot of perpendicular from A to OP). P is on line OP beyond B. PA is tangent: OA ⊥ PA, PA = √(OP² − OA²). In right △OAB: OA² = OB² + AB² confirms B on OP. We need PA: Using similar triangles or Pythagoras in △ABP: AP² = OP² − OA² (tangent). Also in △ABP: right angle at B, AP² = AB² + BP². Let BP = x, then OP = OB + BP = 6 + x. AP² = (6+x)² − 100. Also AP² = 64 + x². So 64 + x² = (6+x)² − 100 = 36 + 12x + x² − 100. Thus 64 = −64 + 12x, giving 128 = 12x, x = 32/3 cm. Therefore PB = 32/3 cm.

sub_questions.text_english:
The median of the following data is 137. Find the values of x and y, given that total of frequencies is 68.
Class: 65-85, 85-105, 105-125, 125-145, 145-165, 165-185, 185-205
Frequency: 4, 5, x, 20, 14, y, 4

key_points: Sum of frequencies: 4+5+x+20+14+y+4 = 68 => x + y = 21.
Median = 137 lies in class 125-145 (cf up to 125-145 is 9+x, f = 20, n/2 = 34).

sub_questions.solution: Total frequency = 4 + 5 + x + 20 + 14 + y + 4 = 47 + x + y = 68, so x + y = 21. Cumulative frequencies: up to 85: 4, up to 105: 9, up to 125: 9+x, up to 145: 29+x, up to 165: 43+x, up to 185: 43+x+y, up to 205: 47+x+y = 68. n/2 = 34. Since median = 137 lies in class 125–145, the median class is 125–145 with l = 125, f = 20, cf = 9+x, h = 20. Median formula: 137 = 125 + [(34 − (9+x))/20] × 20. So 12 = 25 − x, giving x = 13. Then y = 21 − 13 = 8.

questions.text: बिंदु X, △ABC की माध्यिका AD पर स्थित ऐसा बिंदु है कि AX : XD = 2 : 3 है। BX को बढ़ाने पर यह भुजा AC को बिंदु Y पर प्रतिच्छेद करती है। सिद्ध कीजिए कि BX = 4 XY है।
questions.text_english: In △ABC, AD is a median. X is a point on AD such that AX : XD = 2 : 3. BX is extended so that it intersects AC at Y. Prove that BX = 4 XY.

key_points: Draw DM parallel to BY meeting AC at M. Use BPT in triangle ADM and also in triangle with D.
Find AY/YM and AM/MC using the given ratio, then conclude BX = 4XY.

questions.image_description: Triangle ABC with AD as median (D is midpoint of BC). X is a point on AD with AX:XD = 2:3. BX extended meets AC at Y.
questions.solution: Draw DM ∥ BY, where M is on AC. In △AYB, since DM ∥ YB (by construction), by BPT: AD/DM... Let us use vectors or mass point. Let D be midpoint of BC (AD is median). In △ABY, draw DM ∥ BY meeting AY at M. By BPT in △ABY with D on AB... Instead: In △BXA and △YXD are similar (AA): since AD is median, D is midpoint of BC, draw DZ ∥ BX meeting AC at Z. In △BXY (with X between B and Y), take D: since DX ∥ … Apply Menelaus theorem in △ADC with transversal BXY. Actually: Draw DM ∥ BX meeting AC extended at M. In △ABX with DM ∥ BX (D on AB... no). In △AXY, DM ∥ XY where D is on... Using the result: since AX:XD = 2:3, and D is midpoint of BC, using coordinate geometry: Let A = (0,6), B = (−3,0), C = (3,0), D = (0,0). X divides AD in 2:3, so X = (0, 6−2×6/5) = (0, 6/5). Line BX: from B(−3,0) to X(0,6/5). Direction (3, 6/5). Parametric: (−3+3t, 6t/5). At AC: A=(0,6), C=(3,0). AC: x/3 + y/6 =1, i.e. 2x+y = 6. Substituting: 2(−3+3t)+(6t/5)=6 ⇒ −6+6t+6t/5=6 ⇒ 6t+6t/5=12 ⇒ t(1+1/5)=2 ⇒ t×6/5=2 ⇒ t=5/3. Y = (−3+5, 6/3) = (2,2). BX = distance from B(−3,0) to X(0,6/5) = √(9+36/25) = √(261/25) = √261/5. XY = distance from X(0,6/5) to Y(2,2) = √(4+(2−6/5)²) = √(4+(4/5)²) = √(4+16/25) = √(116/25) = √116/5. BX/XY = √261/√116 = √(261/116). But 261 = 9×29 and 116 = 4×29, so BX/XY = √(9/4) = 3/2. That means BX = 3/2 XY, not 4XY. Let me re-examine: AX:XD = 2:3, so X divides AD internally 2:3 from A. A=(0,6), D=(0,0): X = (0, 6−2×6/5) = (0, 6−2.4) = (0, 3.6) = (0, 18/5). BX from B(−3,0) to X(0,18/5): at Y on AC: 2x+y=6, (−3+3t, (18/5)t). 2(−3+3t)+(18/5)t=6 ⇒ −6+6t+18t/5=6 ⇒ 6t+18t/5=12 ⇒ t(30+18)/5=12 ⇒ 48t/5=12 ⇒ t=5/4. Y=(−3+15/4, 18/5×5/4)=(−3+3.75, 18/4)=(0.75, 4.5)=(3/4, 9/2). BX = dist B to X = √(9+(18/5)²) = √(9+324/25) = √(225+324)/25 = √(549/25). XY = dist X to Y = √((3/4)²+(9/2−18/5)²) = √(9/16+(45/10−36/10)²) = √(9/16+(9/10)²) = √(9/16+81/100). LCM 400: √(225/400+324/400) = √(549/400). BX/XY = √(549/25)/√(549/400) = √(400/25) = √16 = 4. So BX = 4XY. Proved.

sub_questions.text: निम्नलिखित रैखिक समीकरण युग्म को ग्राफीय विधि से हल कीजिए : x − 2y = 3, 3x − 8y = 7
sub_questions.text_english: Solve the following system of equations graphically: x − 2y = 3, 3x − 8y = 7

key_points: From x - 2y = 3: when y=0, x=3; when y=-1, x=1. Plot these.
From 3x - 8y = 7: when y=1, x=5; when y=-1, x=-1/3. Plot these.
Intersection point is x = 5, y = 1.

sub_questions.solution: For x − 2y = 3: when y = 0, x = 3 (point (3, 0)); when y = −1, x = 1 (point (1, −1)). For 3x − 8y = 7: when y = 1, x = 5 (point (5, 1)); when y = −1, x = −11/3 ≈ −0.33 (point (−1/3, −1)). Plot both lines on the same graph. The two lines intersect at the point (5, 1). Verification: x − 2y = 5 − 2 = 3 ✓; 3(5) − 8(1) = 15 − 8 = 7 ✓. Solution: x = 5, y = 1.

sub_questions.text: पाँच वर्ष पहले आदिल की उम्र भरत की उम्र की तीन गुना थी और दस वर्ष पश्चात् आदिल की उम्र भरत की उम्र की दोगुना होगी। आदिल तथा भरत की वर्तमान उम्र जानने के लिए: (i) उपर्युक्त परिस्थिति के आधार पर रैखिक समीकरण बनाइए। (ii) दर्शाइए कि रैखिक समीकरण युग्म संगत है तथा इसका अद्वितीय हल है। (iii) आदिल तथा भरत की वर्तमान आयु ज्ञात कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: Five years ago, Adil was thrice as old as Bharat. Ten years later Adil shall be twice as old as Bharat. To know the present ages of Adil and Bharat: (i) form the linear equations representing the above information. (ii) show that the system of equations is consistent with unique solution. (iii) find the present ages of Adil and Bharat.

key_points: Let Adil's age = a, Bharat's age = b. Equations: a-5 = 3(b-5) => a - 3b = -10; a+10 = 2(b+10) => a - 2b = 10.
a1/a2 = 1/1, b1/b2 = -3/-2 = 3/2, not equal, so unique solution.
Subtracting: -b = -20, b = 20. a = 10 + 2(20) = 50. Adil = 50, Bharat = 20.

sub_questions.solution: (i) Let Adil’s present age = a years and Bharat’s present age = b years. Five years ago: a − 5 = 3(b − 5) ⇒ a − 3b = −10. Ten years later: a + 10 = 2(b + 10) ⇒ a − 2b = 10. (ii) For the system a − 3b = −10 and a − 2b = 10: a₁/a₂ = 1/1 = 1 but b₁/b₂ = −3/−2 = 3/2 ≠ 1. Since a₁/a₂ ≠ b₁/b₂, the system is consistent with a unique solution. (iii) Subtracting equation 1 from equation 2: (a − 2b) − (a − 3b) = 10 − (−10), giving b = 20. Substituting: a − 2(20) = 10, so a = 50. Adil’s present age is 50 years and Bharat’s present age is 20 years.

questions.text: समतल भूमि पर खड़ा एक लड़का 60 m लम्बी डोरी की सहायता से 30° के उन्नयन कोण पर एक पतंग उड़ा रहा है। दूसरा लड़का 20 m ऊँचे भवन की छत पर खड़ा है और उसी पतंग का उन्नयन कोण 45° पाता है। यदि दोनों लड़के पतंग की विपरीत दिशाओं में खड़े हों, तो भवन के आधार से पहले लड़के की दूरी तथा पतंग की भूमि से ऊँचाई ज्ञात कीजिए। (√3 = 1.73 लीजिए)
questions.text_english: A boy standing on a horizontal plane is flying a kite with a string of length 60 m, at an angle of elevation of 30°. Another boy standing on the roof of a 20 m high building, finds the angle of elevation of same kite to be 45°. If both the boys are on opposite sides of the kite, find the distance of the first boy from the base of the building. Also, find the height of the kite from the ground. (Use √3 = 1.73)

key_points: Height of kite = 60 sin 30 = 30 m.
Horizontal distance from boy 1 to kite = 60 cos 30 = 30sqrt(3) m.

Height of kite above building roof = 30 - 20 = 10 m. Horizontal distance from kite to building = 10 (since angle 45 implies equal height and distance). Distance of boy 1 from building = 30sqrt(3) + 10 = 30(1.73) + 10 = 51.9 + 10 = 61.9 m.

questions.solution: Let the kite be at point K. Boy 1 is on the ground at A flying with string AK = 60 m at 30° elevation. Height of kite = AK sin 30° = 60 × 0.5 = 30 m. Horizontal distance from A to point below K = 60 cos 30° = 60 × (√3/2) = 30√3 m. Boy 2 is on the roof of a 20 m building at point B (height 20 m). The kite is 30 m above ground, so it is 30 − 20 = 10 m above the roof. The angle of elevation from B to K is 45°. tan 45° = 1, so horizontal distance from B to the point below K = 10 m. The boys are on opposite sides, so distance from A to base of building = 30√3 + 10 = 30(1.73) + 10 = 51.9 + 10 = 61.9 m. Height of kite from ground = 30 m.

questions.text:
रंगमंच के नाटक के दौरान, मंच की पृष्ठभूमि के लिए भवन मेहराब (arches) का प्रयोग किया गया। नीचे दिखाई गई एक मेहराब (arch) के वक्र को बहुपद p(x) = − x² + 2x + 8 के द्वारा निरूपित किया जा सकता है। यहाँ x मंच की सतह पर लम्बाई (फुट में) को दर्शाता है।

उपर्युक्त आकृति के आधार पर निम्नलिखित प्रश्नों के उत्तर दीजिए।
questions.text_english:
During a theatre drama, a backdrop of building arches was used. The shape of the curve shown below can be represented by the polynomial p(x) = − x² + 2x + 8, where x is the length (in feet) on stage level.

Based on the figure given above, answer the following questions:

sub_questions.text: मेहराब की ऊँचाई ज्ञात कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: Determine the height of the arch.

key_points: Height = p(1) = -1 + 2 + 8 = 9 feet (maximum value at vertex x=1).

sub_questions.solution: The height of the arch is the maximum value of p(x) = −x² + 2x + 8. The vertex occurs at x = −b/(2a) = −2/(2×(−1)) = 1. Height = p(1) = −(1)² + 2(1) + 8 = −1 + 2 + 8 = 9 feet.

sub_questions.text: बहुपद p(x) के शून्यक ज्ञात कीजिए। उपर्युक्त ग्राफ में कौन-से बिंदु शून्यक को दर्शाते हैं?
sub_questions.text_english: Find zeroes of the polynomial p(x). Which points on the graph represent the zeroes?

key_points: Points A(4,0) and B(-2,0) on the graph represent the zeroes.

sub_questions.solution: Setting p(x) = 0: −x² + 2x + 8 = 0, i.e., x² − 2x − 8 = 0. Factorising: (x − 4)(x + 2) = 0. So x = 4 or x = −2. The zeroes are 4 and −2. On the graph, the points A(4, 0) and B(−2, 0) represent the zeroes, as they are the x-intercepts of the curve.

sub_questions.text: मंच की सतह पर मेहराब का विस्तार (span) ज्ञात कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: Find the span of the arch on the stage floor.

key_points: Span = distance between the two zeroes = 4 - (-2) = 6 feet.

sub_questions.solution: The span of the arch on the stage floor is the distance between the two x-intercepts (zeroes) of p(x). The zeroes are x = 4 and x = −2. Span = 4 − (−2) = 6 feet.

sub_questions.text: उपर्युक्त वक्र तथा y-अक्ष के प्रतिच्छेदी बिंदु के निर्देशांक लिखिए।
sub_questions.text_english: Write the coordinates of the point of intersection of the above curve with the y-axis.

key_points: At x = 0: p(0) = 8. Point is (0, 8).

sub_questions.solution: The curve intersects the y-axis when x = 0. p(0) = −(0)² + 2(0) + 8 = 8. The coordinates of the point of intersection with the y-axis are (0, 8).

questions.text: कुछ दोस्त ताश की दो एकसमान गड्डियों को लेकर उनसे ताश खेलना चाहते थे। ताश के पत्तों को फेंटते समय तीन पत्ते नीचे गिर गए। उन्होंने शेष पत्तों को अच्छी प्रकार फेंटकर यादृच्छया एक पत्ता निकाला। यह मानते हुए कि गिरे हुए तीन पत्तों में एक पान की बेगम, एक हुकुम का दस तथा एक चिड़ी का इक्का है, निम्नलिखित प्रश्नों के उत्तर दीजिए:
questions.text_english: A group of friends wanted to play cards with two identical packs together. While shuffling the cards, three cards are dropped. Rest of the cards are shuffled and one card is drawn at random. Assuming that the dropped cards were a queen of hearts, a ten of spades and an ace of clubs, answer the following questions:

sub_questions.text: इसकी क्या प्रायिकता है कि निकाला गया पत्ता एक फेस कार्ड (face card) है?
sub_questions.text_english: Find the probability that the drawn card is a face card.

key_points: Two packs = 104 cards. 3 dropped. Remaining = 101. Face cards in 2 packs = 2x12 = 24. Dropped face card = queen of hearts = 1. Remaining face cards = 23. P = 23/101.

sub_questions.solution: Two identical packs together have 104 cards. After removing 3 dropped cards, 101 cards remain. In two packs, total face cards (Jack, Queen, King of each suit × 2 packs) = 3 × 4 × 2 = 24. One dropped card is a queen of hearts (a face card), so remaining face cards = 24 − 1 = 23. Probability = 23/101.

sub_questions.text: प्रायिकता ज्ञात कीजिए कि निकाला गया पत्ता बेगम या बादशाह है।
sub_questions.text_english: Find the probability that the drawn card is either a king or a queen.

key_points: Kings in 2 packs = 8. Queens in 2 packs = 8. Queen of hearts dropped, so remaining queens = 7. Total kings or queens = 8 + 7 = 15. P = 15/101.

sub_questions.solution: In two packs: total kings = 8, total queens = 8. One queen (queen of hearts) was dropped, so remaining queens = 7. Remaining kings = 8 (none dropped). Total king or queen cards = 8 + 7 = 15. Probability = 15/101.

sub_questions.text: क्या आपको लगता है कि यदि कोई पत्ता नहीं गिरता, तो निकाले गए पत्ते के बेगम होने की प्रायिकता ज्यादा होती? तर्क सहित उत्तर दीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: Do you think that the probability of getting a queen was higher if none of the cards were dropped? Justify your answer.

key_points: With no cards dropped: P(queen) = 8/104 = 2/26 = 1/13.
With 3 dropped (including one queen): P(queen) = 7/101.
Compare: 8/104 vs 7/101. 8/104 = 0.0769, 7/101 = 0.0693. So yes, probability was higher without dropping.

sub_questions.solution: If no cards were dropped, probability of getting a queen = 8/104 = 1/13 ≈ 0.0769. After dropping (including one queen), probability = 7/101 ≈ 0.0693. Since 1/13 > 7/101, yes, the probability of getting a queen would be higher if none of the cards were dropped. This is because dropping a queen card reduced both the numerator (queens available) and the total count, but the reduction in queens (from 8 to 7) is proportionally greater.

sub_questions.text: प्रायिकता ज्ञात कीजिए कि निकाला गया पत्ता गुलाम है। इसकी तुलना उस स्थिति में निकाली गई प्रायिकता से कीजिए यदि कोई पत्ता नहीं गिरता। किस परिस्थिति में निकाले गए पत्ते के गुलाम होने की प्रायिकता अधिक है?
sub_questions.text_english: Find the probability that the drawn card is a jack. Compare it with the probability when none of the cards were dropped. In which case is the probability of getting a jack higher?

key_points: Jacks in 2 packs = 8. No jack was dropped. P(jack after dropping) = 8/101.
P(jack without dropping) = 8/104 = 1/13.
8/101 > 8/104, so probability of jack is higher after dropping.

sub_questions.solution: In two packs there are 8 jacks. None of the dropped cards was a jack, so remaining jacks = 8 out of 101 cards. Probability of drawing a jack = 8/101. If no cards were dropped, P(jack) = 8/104 = 1/13. Comparing: 8/101 vs 8/104. Since 101 < 104, we have 8/101 > 8/104. Therefore, the probability of getting a jack is higher in the case where the three cards were dropped (i.e., after dropping), because the total number of cards decreased while the number of jacks remained the same.

questions.text:
मेज पर रखने के लिए 'लीफी बॉल फाउन्टेन' का एक मॉडल बनाया गया। पानी सहजता से गेंद की सतह से बहता हुआ एक सुसज्जित बेलनाकार टंकी में जाता है जहाँ से पुन: वापस आता है।

गोलाकार गेंद का व्यास 21 cm है।
बेलनाकार टंकी – बाह्य व्यास 50 cm है तथा आंतरिक व्यास 40 cm है।
ठोस आधार की ऊँचाई 14 cm है।
भरे हुए पानी की ऊँचाई 7 cm है।

उपर्युक्त आकृति के आधार पर निम्नलिखित प्रश्नों के उत्तर दीजिए:
questions.text_english:
A model of Leafy Ball Fountain is made to be kept on the tabletop. Water gently cascades down the ball into a decorative cylindrical pool where it is recycled.

The diameter of spherical ball is 21 cm.
Cylindrical pool – Outer diameter is 50 cm and inner diameter is 40 cm.
Height of solid base is 14 cm.
Height of water filled is 7 cm.

Observe the figure and answer the following questions:

sub_questions.text: फव्वारे की कुल ऊँचाई ज्ञात कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: Determine the total height of the fountain.

key_points: Total height = height of solid base + diameter of ball = 14 + 21 = 35 cm.

sub_questions.solution: The total height of the fountain = height of solid cylindrical base + diameter of spherical ball = 14 + 21 = 35 cm.

sub_questions.text: गेंद का आयतन ज्ञात कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: Find the volume of the ball.

sub_questions.text: यदि गेंद का एक-तिहाई हिस्सा पानी में डूबा हो, तो टंकी में पानी का आयतन ज्ञात कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: If one-third of the ball is submerged in the water, find the volume of the water filled in the pool.

key_points: Volume of water in pool = Volume of cylindrical water space - Volume of submerged ball part.
Inner radius = 20 cm. Volume of water column (height 7 cm) = pi(20)^2(7) = 2800 pi.

sub_questions.solution: Inner radius of cylindrical pool = 40/2 = 20 cm. Height of water = 7 cm. Volume of cylindrical water region = πr²h = (22/7)(20)²(7) = (22/7)(400)(7) = 22 × 400 = 8800 cm³. Volume of ball submerged = (1/3) × 4851 = 1617 cm³. Volume of water in pool = 8800 − 1617 = 7183 cm³.

sub_questions.text: बेलनाकार भाग का बाह्य वक्र पृष्ठीय क्षेत्रफल तथा गेंद के पृष्ठीय क्षेत्रफल का योगफल ज्ञात कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: Find the sum of the outer curved surface area of the cylindrical part and surface area of the ball.

key_points: Outer radius of cylinder = 25 cm, height = 14 cm. CSA = 2 pi r h = 2(22/7)(25)(14) = 2200 cm^2.

sub_questions.solution: Outer radius of cylindrical part = 50/2 = 25 cm. Height of solid base = 14 cm. Outer curved surface area of cylinder = 2πrh = 2 × (22/7) × 25 × 14 = 2 × 22 × 25 × 2 = 2200 cm². Surface area of ball = 4πr² = 4 × (22/7) × (10.5)² = 4 × (22/7) × 110.25 = 4 × 22 × 15.75 = 4 × 346.5 = 1386 cm². Sum = 2200 + 1386 = 3586 cm².
